scope: Reconcile the PAR-130 DXF group-code boundary with official type references and independent writer architecture; refresh related binary-DXF peer reports and the evidence ceilings for DWG/DXF 3D routes; refine only existing plan owners for speed and readiness.

method.kind: Primary-source web review plus read-only local source/plan inspection
method.limitations: Peer issue details remain reporter claims and are not libdxfrw reproductions. Current mutable repository source is not a release qualification. No current native FreeCAD, LibreDWG, or ACadSharp output was produced in this review.

findings.topic: DXF scalar and carrier type boundaries
findings.observed: Autodesk's current table confirms XDATA 1000-1009 strings, 1010-1059 doubles, 1060-1070 16-bit integers, 1071 32-bit integer, 290-299 Boolean flags, and 310-319 binary chunks. The local PAR-130 change maps the 1009/1010 edge correctly; 1004 remains the dedicated binary-chunk code.
findings.evidenceCeiling: The official type table is an independent map for DXF group-code typing; it does not establish every serializer call site, target profile, consumer behavior, or the libdxfrw LibreCAD-legacy override policy.
findings.planUse: Use a test-only type oracle transcribed from Autodesk, separate binary chunks from NUL-terminated strings, and exercise AC1009's group-code framing separately from modern two-byte code framing.

findings.topic: ACadRust issue #136 and code-driven writer strategy
findings.observed: Open issue #136 reports 60 fixed-width call sites across 15 codes in ACadRust 0.6.4 and says its own reader accepts the misaligned output. The report is a useful failure-mode lead, not evidence about libdxfrw. Current ezdxf BinaryTagWriter selects scalar widths from explicit code sets and has a distinct binary-chunk path; its own documentation warns that some proxy/third-party binary output may still fail target applications.
findings.evidenceCeiling: Neither issue prose nor ezdxf source proves the behavior of an exact libdxfrw build or target application. Self-readback and centralized dispatch alone do not establish end-to-end format interoperability.
findings.planUse: Continue existing PAR-39/7X work. Prefer a shared sink-level code/type guard plus independent byte scanning, but preserve raw/opaque replay and target-application qualification as separate routes.

findings.topic: Local binary sink and embedded-NUL exposure
findings.observed: Local dxfWriterBinary writeInt16/writeInt32/writeInt64/writeDouble/writeBool emit the requested width without validating the group's expected kind. The dxfWriter layer already carries standalone and LibreCAD-master legacy classifier profiles. Ordinary binary writeString rejects embedded NUL through isSafeBinaryDxfString; group 1004 and 310-319 use a separate chunk encoder.
findings.evidenceCeiling: This source inspection confirms a guard/readiness gap, not a new defect count; existing PAR-39 records local mismatches and the 667-call scan was bounded. No complete current census or raw-wire full matrix was rerun here.
findings.planUse: Do not add a duplicate NUL finding. Complete the existing callsite inventory, propagate classifier profile into the sink, reject known-type mismatches before writing bytes, and preserve opaque/raw routes explicitly.

findings.observed: LibreDWG issue #1411 is scoped to a named 0.14.8593 build while mutable current source has an AcDs read path and NEWS calls AcDs handling incomplete. ACadSharp #1195 describes 3DSOLID/REGION omission in 3.4.9, not the current release. FreeCAD documentation describes stock DWG/DXF as 2D-only through a converter-to-DXF-importer route; CAD Assistant identifies SAT/SAB import as a commercial-component route.
findings.evidenceCeiling: These reports/docs do not qualify current releases, prove local failures, establish B-rep semantics, or supply independent native acceptance. A source entry point or matching entity count does not prove the entity-owner-payload-output chain.
findings.planUse: Keep exact release/build provenance, object identity/owner/payload association, output disposition, and semantic consumer results separate. No change to the existing composed Linux/Windows native and independent semantic gates.

implementationReadySequence: Finish the existing PAR-39/7X literal and dynamic writer callsite census with owner, method, type profile, version gate, and typed-versus-raw route.
Pass the selected standalone or LibreCAD-legacy profile to dxfWriterBinary before the first value; known typed methods must validate kind before emitting code/value bytes.
Keep group 999 rejection, R12 framing, 1004/310-319 chunk encoding, and identity/provenance-gated unknown/raw replay as explicit paths.
Fix only concrete failing serializer owners identified by focused generated tests; do not weaken classifier ranges to make an incorrect call pass.

Use an independent in-memory raw walker checking ordered tags, exact widths, Boolean values, chunk lengths, full EOF consumption, a following sentinel, pre-emission mismatch failure, and destination-preserving public rejection.

For each slice run only the focused selector, strict owning target, and owning CTest; compatibility build only for public/consumer contract changes; keep broad matrices/full suites at scheduled family checkpoints.

existingOwnersRefined: PAR-39 / 7X binary DXF writer-width inventory and repair
